parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (()=>{const R=(a)=>(((a||{}).data)||{}).Data||[];const OR=(f,ids)=>ids.length?'('+ids.map(i=>'('+f+" = '"+i+"')").join(' OR ')+')':"("+f+" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')";const m=$('⚙️ הגדרות').first().json;const c=m.cfg;const inWin=(x)=>{const e=String(x.pcfEstimatedEndDate||'').slice(0,10);return e&&e>=m.today&&e<=m.renewalTarget&&Number(e.slice(0,4))<c.RETAINER_SENTINEL_YEAR&&(c.RENEWAL_PROGRAM_LABELS||[]).includes(String(x.pcfCurrentProgram||'').trim())&&(c.COACHING_ACTIVE_LABELS||[]).includes(String(x.pcfStatus||'').trim());};const accs=[...new Set(R($json).filter(inWin).map(x=>x.pcfaccountid).filter(Boolean))];return JSON.stringify({objecttype:4,page_size:500,page_number:1,fields:'opportunityid,name,accountid,statuscode,pcfProduct,createdon,pcfCourse,pcfParentSale,pcfWhatsAppToRef,ownerid,pcfFormFilled,pcfFormLink,pcfTelephone1,pcfemailaddress,pcfFunnels,pcfclosedate',query:OR('accountid',accs)});})() }}
